section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure describes translation/back-translation of the BAS-2 into Persian and data collection between December 2014 and June 2015 at seven large universities in Tehran. Participants were university students who completed a paper-and-pencil survey in classroom settings; the BAS-2 was included and counterbalanced with other measures. No sample size, age, BMI, ethnicity, BMI assessment method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI are reported in this section; there is no mention of 'Study 1' or multiple studies.
